scope: Exploratory postprocessing specified after initial UCI primary test access. Reload fixed primary checkpoints; fit positive-slope temperature or affine calibration on their original validation split only; evaluate every declared model/seed on unchanged test rows. Retain raw primary results. No test labels enter fitting; not an untouched confirmation experiment or claim of a new calibration method.
motivation: Separate calibration sensitivity from ranking and model architecture. NeuralAC has an antisymmetric side-score difference, whereas other static baselines can represent an intercept/side preference. This audit does not identify true causal side advantage.
